name: LethAL Sandbox Layout
brief: LethAL R353 fixture: two files that split into two batches across a member boundary.
description: Two single-object codeunits. At maxGuardsPerBatch 7 each is its own batch, so batch 1 instruments a file batch 0 copied verbatim. Run by itest:alrunner so a coverage index kept across deploy() moves a per-mutant verdict. Deliberately its OWN app and id range so no other frozen baseline moves. Not for production use, see fixtures/README.md.
